title: (0Day) Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Power Monitoring Expert GetFilteredSinkProvider Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Power Monitoring Expert. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the GetFilteredSinkProvider method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of LOCAL SERVICE.
